headline: Anthropic's Mythos AI reportedly breached 'almost all' NSA classified systems in hours
summary: A controlled red-team test revealed the AI model's capability, leading to a U.S. government ban on foreign nationals accessing Fable 5 and Mythos 5.
details: Anthropic's powerful Mythos AI model was reportedly able to access "almost all" classified National Security Agency (NSA) systems within hours during a controlled security evaluation. This claim was made by Sen. Mark Warner, citing NSA head Gen. Joshua Rudd, and shed light on the U.S. government's recent ban on foreign nationals accessing Fable 5 and Mythos 5.

The U.S. government's directive on June 12th barred all foreign nationals from accessing these AI models, citing national security concerns. Anthropic responded by disabling the models globally, stating they could not practically enforce nationality-based restrictions without affecting all users.

Anthropic contends the reported breach was a narrow jailbreak, similar to those exhibited by rival models like OpenAI's GPT-5.5. They describe the behavior as asking the model to analyze and fix code, which revealed minor, already known bugs rather than an autonomous intrusion.

The security evaluation occurred on June 11th, one day before the ban. Anthropic is working with the White House on a collaborative risk-management framework, while also continuing work with the NSA under Project Glasswing, adapting Mythos for specific operational applications.
